methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: The VCU-AI Ready RVA partnership signals distributed capability-building through community-anchored education infrastructure, creating pathways for deep fluency beyond elite tech concentrations if implementation reaches diverse populations.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-funded community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia represents deliberate distribution strategy toward economically transitioning regions, testing whether deep capability can take root outside traditional tech hubs through place-based investment.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: AI pressure on Richmond's young workforce without corresponding deep training infrastructure signals shallow adoption anxiety—workers feeling displacement threats without acquiring genuine capability to shape AI deployment.

signals.title: AI bills faced a logjam in the General Assembly due to a Trump executive order, but Congress is working to fill the gap
signals.signal_reading: Legislative paralysis on AI policy combined with federal broadband funding threats shows how regulatory uncertainty and infrastructure gaps in underserved regions prevent both shallow platform adoption and deep capability development from materializing.

signals.title: Danville to consider data center tax increase, development guidelines
signals.signal_reading: Danville pursuing data center development represents infrastructure concentration rather than capability distribution—hosting compute power creates tax revenue but not necessarily local AI fluency unless paired with workforce development mechanisms.
